title: fix(sw): log cache put errors instead of swallowing silently
body:
In the Service Worker caching logic (`handleFetchCacheFirst` and `handleFetchNetworkFirst`), a failed `cache.put` operation (such as from a `QuotaExceededError`) was caught and silently ignored via an empty `.catch(() => {})` block. This violates the Sentinel mandate to avoid silent swallows and ensure failures are observable.

This patch replaces the empty catch blocks with an error log that provides context (`[ServiceWorker] Cache put failed`), safely guarded by a `self.console.warn` availability check to avoid secondary exceptions during error handling. Corresponding test assertions were added to `sw.test.js` and verified with 100% line coverage.

- **Lane**: Sentinel
